rowe-kennicutt-2009.citation: Rowe and Kennicutt (2009), Northern Gulf of Mexico Continental Slope Habitats and Benthic Ecology Study, Final Report, MMS 2009-039, July 2009.

source_locator: Printed page 83 / PDF page 105 identifies Quick to the west and QE2 to the east after summer split near 24 N. Figure 8-5 printed page 82 / PDF page 104 dated August 8, 2002 supplies the manual proxy.
association_rule: Punctuation-normalized source name plus explicit secondary split context; qualified source-case association only, not a physical crosswalk.

manual_proxy.landmark: Center of the orange closed high east of the western Quick feature along approximately 24 N, west of the Loop Current; not the northern warm-slope highs.

findings.qe2: Eastern split feature along about 24 N is distinguished from western Quick and northern slope anticyclones. Fixed manual map proxy at 88.2 W, 23.8 N supplies numerical selection only. No exact center, physical boundary, measured size or lifetime inferred.
